consent.privacyBody: My clinic and RI'AYA process my personal and health data to manage my care, appointments and reminders. I can ask my clinic to access or correct my data at any time.
consent.aiBody: The assistant answers questions about your appointments and helps you book them. When it is on, the messages you send and the appointment details it needs are processed by Claude, an AI model from Anthropic. It never gives a diagnosis or prescribes, and it cannot change anything without your confirmation. You can turn it off at any time in your profile.
